caption: Receive colour: the colour sent by the Send colour named paint, masked by the wave
why: Colour wires cross a graph as much as number wires do. Send colour and Receive colour carry a colour by name instead: whatever feeds a Send colour named paint comes out of every Receive colour named paint.
Its neighbours: Send and Receive for numbers; Knot colour to route a colour wire; sub-graphs to hide wiring.
steps: A Send colour named paint carries a scrolling **Palette** colour.
This Receive colour's **name** is paint, so its `out` is that colour; a **Mask** shows it by a **Wave**, and it goes to the **Output**.
A Receive colour whose name no Send colour has is an error, shown on the node.

try.label: Lose the Send
try.text: name brush: no Send colour has that name - the node says so until it matches again.
